# porch_service_account (Resource)

A tenant service account (machine identity, ADR-0037). It obtains access tokens from `token_endpoint` with the client credentials grant, using its `id` as `client_id` and `client_secret`. Grant it roles with `porch_role_assignment` (`subject_type = "service_account"`). Needs `service_account:manage`. The secret is returned only at creation; it is kept in state (sensitive) and never re-read. Change `secret_version` to rotate it. Import with `<tenant>/<service_account_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "porch_service_account" "backup" {
  tenant                   = porch_tenant.smiths.id
  slug                     = "backup"
  name                     = "Nightly backup"
  audiences                = ["https://nas.smith.example"]
  access_token_ttl_seconds = 300
  secret_version           = "2026-10" # change to rotate the secret
}

resource "porch_role_assignment" "backup_reader" {
  tenant       = porch_tenant.smiths.id
  subject_type = "service_account"
  subject_id   = porch_service_account.backup.id
  role_id      = porch_role.media_viewer.id
}

# client_credentials: client_id = id, client_secret = client_secret, token URL = token_endpoint.
output "backup_client_secret" {
  value     = porch_service_account.backup.client_secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name.
- `slug` (String) Identifier, unique in the tenant. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `tenant` (String) ID or slug of the tenant that owns this object. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `access_token_ttl_seconds` (Number) Access token lifetime (60..3600, default 600).
- `audiences` (Set of String) API audiences its access tokens may target (RFC 8707 `resource` values).
- `description` (String) Description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Disabled service accounts fail every check and cannot obtain tokens. Default `true`.
- `secret_version` (String) Arbitrary value; changing it (including setting it for the first time, e.g. after an import) rotates the secret and stores the new one. The old secret stops working immediately.

### Read-Only

- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Client secret (`porch_sa_…`). Only known after create (or rotation); never re-read.
- `id` (String) Service account ID (`sva_…`), also its OAuth `client_id`.
- `token_endpoint` (String) OAuth token endpoint to use with the client credentials grant.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import porch_service_account.backup <tenant>/<service_account_id>   # the secret is unknown until rotated
```
